I will use SARO rice seed on my 0.85 hectare plot because my neighbor got a good yield with it last season, and I will buy one bag of DAP and one bag of urea from the agro-dealer when the subsidy vouchers arrive — that is what I used last year and it gave me a decent harvest. My wife and children will do the planting, weeding, and most of the harvesting, which takes us about 50 days altogether across the season. I will hire three workers from the village for three or four days each at harvest time because we must cut and thresh quickly before the weather turns, so about 10 days of hired labor in total. I do not spray chemicals on rice — the seed is clean and we can pull the weeds by hand — and this plot is rainfed, I do not have a pump or canal to irrigate it.
